summary: Welltower Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution agreement allowing issuance and sale of up to $7.5 billion of common stock. The company terminated a prior October 2025 equity distribution agreement after having sold $6.632 billion under it. The new program includes forward sale agreements whereby forward sellers borrow and sell shares, with Welltower expecting to physically settle and receive cash proceeds. No specific price per share, premium, or close date is stated. This is a capital-raising facility, not an acquisition or other special situation, but the substantial size and replacement of a prior program signal ongoing capital returns activity. What to watch: pace of takedowns and any use of proceeds for acquisitions or debt reduction.
